finding.headline: "The Twin Mama"
finding.problem: "Two babies, one of me. I'm feeding someone every hour and I haven't eaten a full meal in days. I'm running on air."
finding.recurring_situation: HIDDEN MARKET — "Feeding the mother while she's feeding the baby"
finding.person: A 31-yr-old mum of newborn twins, tandem-feeding 8–12×/day, zero time, ravenous, needs double-batch + high-calorie lactation food she can eat one-handed.
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Standalone — "Double Trouble, Double Fuel: One-Handed Lactation Meals for Twin Mums."". Verdict: PASSES (19/25)..
